Ranking fix 2026-09-22: reward-dollar ceilings that were filed as spend caps are now applied as reward caps, and a capped card whose post-cap rate is not established scores 0 past the cap rather than keeping the bonus rate.
🏬 in-store (Visa credit or PIN debit) · 🌐 Costco.com only (Mastercard) · ✖ neither (Amex, Discover — Costco.com dropped Discover in 2023) · ? unknown network
Best case = every boost applied, points at TPG Sep-2026 ¢/pt. Floor = no boosts, points cashed at 1¢. A bonus needing a single swipe over $5,000 is treated as unreachable.
An amber +1.80%? is an unconfirmed debit-pay rail kept alive as a lead. Taekus itself is UNCONFIRMED (debit→card-bill may code as AFT/MCC 6012 and pay nothing). ⚠ review = non-crypto over 6.0%.
